location_note: North-eastern part of Beit Safafa, 1.5 km north-east of Landau's excavation; map ref. 1672-4/1278-85 (Old Israel Grid, 4-digit).
notes: Stratum III Iron Age II winepress complex with many rock-cut and plastered installations; Stratum II Byzantine farmhouse with a cistern; Stratum I Byzantine/Early Islamic pen. Hellenistic and Early Roman finds only as sherds and coins (no feature). Landau's vaulted Byzantine family tomb is cited from 1957; not coded. Channels and gutters inside the winepress are part of the winepress row (choice C4).

features.subtype: complex rock-cut winepress (treading floors A-D, settling tank H, vats E, F, channel G), plastered pit K (diam. 5 m), basin L151, depressions and plastered installations L171, L175, L182, L186, L191, L206, L208; Byzantine rock-hewn installation L210
features.period: Stratum III, Iron Age II (some reused in Stratum II); L210 Byzantine
features.quote: Stratum III: An Iron Age rock-cut winepress and other rock-cut installations.

features.subtype: stone quarry with cutting marks (probe 4 x 7 m)
features.quote: remains of a stone quarry were uncovered (see Plan 2)

features.subtype: stepped plastered installation L194 with four wide steps and two sumps; excavator: not a miqveh, possibly a water reservoir for washing or purification
features.period: attributed to Stratum III (Iron Age) by association with the winepress; mixed Iron Age and Byzantine finds
features.quote: with four wide steps leading down to it, was uncovered

features.subtype: plastered cistern under Room II (3.5 x 7.0 m, 3.5 m deep) with seven-step entrance and ceiling opening; Iron Age Vat F reused as a cistern
features.quote: The cistern was 3.5 × 7.0 m large and 3.5 m deep
